typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	FinalOutboundFileName as string (),
	FinalPRFRecordCount as string (),
	InitialOutboundFileName as string (),
	InitialPRFRecordCount as string (),
	OracleDataSource as string (),
	OraclePassword as string (),
	OracleProvider as string (),
	OracleUserID as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	OutReportName as string (),
	OutReportPath as string ()
}

source(output(
		INITIAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'T\'||TO_CHAR(COUNT(1)+1) AS INITIAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT  FROM AGP.PRF_OUTBOUND_FILE_STAGING PRFS WHERE UPPER(PRFS.PRF_TYPE) = UPPER(\'Initial\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> FetchInitialPRFRecordCount
FetchInitialPRFRecordCount sink(input(
		INITIAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INITIAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT)) ~> InitialPRFWriteRecordCountinTrailer
